related_questions.question: Can I get a copy of my immunization records online in Texas?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, you can get a copy of your immunization records online in Texas through the Texas Immunization Registry, ImmTrac2. You can request your records or your child's records by completing the required forms and submitting them to Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS).
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, you can get a copy of your immunization records online in Texas through the Texas Immunization Registry, ImmTrac2

text_blocks.snippet: Here's how to obtain your records:

list.title: 1. Access the ImmTrac2 Registry:
list.snippet: Visit the Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) ImmTrac2 website to find the necessary forms.

list.title: 2. Complete the Forms:
list.snippet: Download and fill out the appropriate forms, which may include a patient consent form and a request for records form.

list.title: 3. Submit the Forms:
list.snippet: Follow the instructions provided on the DSHS website for submitting the completed forms. This may involve mailing the forms or submitting them electronically.

list.title: 4. Receive Your Records:
list.snippet: Once your request is processed, you will receive your immunization records.

text_blocks.snippet: Note: You may also be able to obtain records from your healthcare provider or the school you attended, as they may have kept copies.
